integrity: The claim is proved analytically from planar facet geometry and the definition of the \(L_p\) surface area measure. Literature comparisons distinguish the exact phase diagram from broader existence and uniqueness theorems.
scientific_limitations: Planar two-atom data only; no classification for three or more atoms or in higher dimension. The finite checker is a consistency test, not an exhaustive proof.
title: Two-atom phase diagram for planar \(L_p\) Minkowski problems in cones
